definitions.explanation: The main part of the human or animal body excluding the head, arms, and legs.

definitions.gloss: fuselage, body (of a vehicle or aircraft)
definitions.explanation: The main body of an aircraft, ship, or other vehicle, excluding wings, tail, and other appendages.

notes:
USAGE:
For the body sense, {胴体|どうたい} refers specifically to the trunk — the core body minus limbs and head. This distinguishes it from ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (the whole body) and {胴|どう} (the torso in martial arts or armor contexts).

For aircraft, {胴体|どうたい} is the standard term for the fuselage, parallel to English aviation terminology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胴体|どうたい}⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧: belly landing
- {胴体|どうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひねる: to twist the torso
- {胴体|どうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧: torso muscles
- ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{胴体|どうたい}: airplane fuselage
